correctness.rationale: For ten triangular maximal facets, E=15, V=7. Five unequal-length base edges pair the ten facets into five genuine quadrilaterals, giving a spherical quadrangulation Q with seven vertices and ten equal-length edges. All Q facial cycles even, hence bipartite. Its smaller class has ≤3 vertices and thus a vertex incident to r≥4 edges. At most two unequal diagonals k touch that vertex because diagonals join a same-class pair in the simple original graph. Its exact incident angle sum is kπ+(r-2k)θ. It is ≥2π for θ≥π/2 and ≥4θ when θ<π/2, giving the stated necessary nonexistence and vertex defect bound. Verified counts and case k≤2 algebraically; no sufficiency is claimed.
